'''Farenan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. She made her living as a stims vendor.
